name: The Doll Collector
summary: Izek Strazni, the Baron's enforcer, has dreamed of a red-haired woman all his life, and has had her face carved over and over.

stages.journal: Izek Strazni, the Baron's enforcer, looked at Ireena as if he had seen her face before, many times.
objectives: Find out why Izek knows Ireena's face

stages.journal: Izek pays Blinsky the toymaker to carve doll after doll of one red-haired woman, and keeps them in a chest at the foot of his bed. They all have Ireena's face.
objectives: Learn what Izek wants with her

stages.journal: Izek lost a little sister in the woods when he was a boy, the night the wolves took his arm. Ireena was found wandering at about that age, with no memory of where she came from. They are brother and sister.
We told Izek who Ireena is. The Baron's fist went quiet as a struck bell. He will not lay a hand on her now, nor, it seems, on anyone else for the Baron.
Izek Strazni is dead. Whatever he dreamed of died with him.
The Baron refused Izek his reward. Izek obeyed, for now, and still watches Ireena whenever she crosses the square.
